basic_details.job_title: GSSSB Manager Grade 2 Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Gujarat Subordinate Service Selection Board (GSSSB), Gandhinagar, has invited applications for the post of Manager (Guest House/Rest House Manager) Grade-2 under Advt No. 470/202627. The online application is open from 1 December 2026 to 15 December 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online only by debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet; transaction fee extra. Last date to pay the fee: 18 December 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Diploma or degree in Hotel Management (or the other listed hotel management, hospitality or tourism qualifications) from a recognised university or institution; basic computer knowledge; adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both
qualification.details: Qualification: A Diploma in Hotel Management / a Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Technology / a Degree in Hotel Management / a Degree in Hotel Management and Catering Technology / a bachelors' degree in Hospitality and Hotel Administration / a Bachelor of Business Administration (Hotel management and Tourism) / a Bachelor of Arts (International Hospitality Administration) / a Bachelor of Science (catering Science and Hotel Management) / a Master of Business Administration (Tourism and Hotel Management) / a Post graduate (Diploma in Tourism and Hotel Management); Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967; Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Age limit: 18 to 37 years (as on 15 December 2026) Age relaxation: General category PwD men 10 years (maximum 45 years), General category PwD women 15 years (maximum 45 years), Reserved category PwD men 15 years (maximum 45 years), Reserved category PwD women 20 years (maximum 45 years) | Other conditions: | Only PwD candidates in the Low Vision group LV (40-70%) can apply for the 1 post. Candidate must be an Indian citizen or have nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. The job is transferable and staying in quarters in the residential institution during duty is compulsory. Candidates without a computer-knowledge certificate may apply but must produce one before appointment.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed pay Rs. 40,800 per month for the first five years

pattern_table.Subject: Reasoning and Data Interpretation; Mathematical tests; Constitution of India, current affairs, Gujarati and English comprehension

exam_pattern.details: Negative marking: one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question is deducted for a wrong answer. Provisional answer key will be published, followed by a final answer key after objections. Exam date, time and admit card instructions will be put on https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in. Scribe and compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) are available to eligible candidates.

how_to_apply: Complete OTR (One Time Registration) on the OJAS website https://ojas.gujarat.gov.in if not already registered.
On OJAS go to Online Application, click Apply and select GSSSB.
Click the post name under advertisement 470/202627, then Apply, and Apply now.
Enter Registration No. and date of birth and click Apply with OTR.
Fill Personal Details, SSC details, bank account details with the first passbook page upload, and Educational Details.
Accept the Declaration, save, and note the Application Number.
Upload photograph and signature in JPG format up to 15 KB.
Confirm the application, note the confirmation number, pay the fee online by 18-12-2026 and print the application.
important_instructions: If more than one application is made, only the last confirmed application is valid. Once confirmed, the application cannot be changed; category change requests are not accepted. Fee is refunded only to candidates who appear in the examination. Scribe/compensatory time requests must be emailed to [email protected] at least two days before the exam.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 470/202627 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download GSSSB notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A Diploma in Hotel Management / a Diploma in Hotel Management and Catering Technology / a Degree in Hotel Management / a Degree in Hotel Management and Catering Technology / a bachelors' degree in Hospitality and Hotel Administration / a Bachelor of Business Administration (Hotel management and Tourism) / a Bachelor of Arts (International Hospitality Administration) / a Bachelor of Science (catering Science and Hotel Management) / a Master of Business Administration (Tourism and Hotel Management) / a Post graduate (Diploma in Tourism and Hotel Management); Basic knowledge of computer application as prescribed in the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967; Adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi or both Age limit: 18 to 37 years (as on 15 December 2026) Age relaxation: General category PwD men 10 years (maximum 45 years), General category PwD women 15 years (maximum 45 years), Reserved category PwD men 15 years (maximum 45 years), Reserved category PwD women 20 years (maximum 45 years) Other conditions: Only PwD candidates in the Low Vision group LV (40-70%) can apply for the 1 post. Candidate must be an Indian citizen or have nationality as per Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. The job is transferable and staying in quarters in the residential institution during duty is compulsory. Candidates without a computer-knowledge certificate may apply but must produce one before appointment.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for GSSSB Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Reserved category candidates applying for an unreserved post get no age or other relaxation. SEBC or EWS candidates without the prescribed certificate get no age relaxation and apply as General category PwD. Candidates currently disqualified by GPSC, other recruitment boards or government bodies are automatically rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Appointment on fixed pay for the first five years. Regular appointment in Level-5 after five years if services are satisfactory, subject to the notice's conditions and the Supreme Court SLP No.14124/2012 and SLP No.14125/2012. Appointed candidates must undergo training and pass the training examination.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online only by debit card, internet banking, UPI or wallet; transaction fee extra. Last date to pay the fee: 18 December 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will GSSSB Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Competitive objective MCQ examination (CBRT/OMR) in two parts, Part-A and Part-B Certificate verification of about twice the number of posts, in merit order by disability group Selection list and waiting list Part-A: reasoning and Data Interpretation 30 marks, mathematical tests 30 marks, Constitution of India, current affairs, Gujarati and English comprehension 30 marks. Part-B: questions on the relevant subject and its utility, 120 marks. Minimum qualifying standard is 40% in Part-A and 40% in Part-B for all categories. About twice the number of posts, by disability group, are called for certificate verification.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Negative marking: one-fourth of the marks allotted to the question is deducted for a wrong answer. Provisional answer key will be published, followed by a final answer key after objections. Exam date, time and admit card instructions will be put on https://gsssb.gujarat.gov.in. Scribe and compensatory time (20 minutes per hour) are available to eligible candidates.

Scribe/compensatory time requests must be emailed to [email protected] at least two days before the exam.
